name: Uta no☆Prince-sama♪  -Amazing Aria-
original_name: うたの☆プリンスさまっ♪ -Amazing Aria-
source:
Nanami Haruka has found her partner and the voice to bring her compositions to life. Yet challenges just don't stop there. To pass the exams, she has to win the graduation auditions with her partner. When emotions get into music, they may make the melody sweeter, but couple fights could stump your work in progress. Learn to deal with the princes as a girlfriend and combine all aspects of romance into your songs.

Amazing Aria has new characters for you to date. If you were really successful in the first game, load your data into the new game to push your love gauge to a new max. Be sure, too, to enjoy the new music and the new event illustrations.

[From [url=http://www.play-asia.com/Uta_no_PrinceSama_Amazing_Aria_Welcome_Set/paOS-13-71-9f-49-en-70-3ymn.html]Play-Asia[/url]]
translation:
七海春歌已经找到了搭档，也找到了能让自己创作的乐曲获得生命的歌声。然而，挑战远未结束。为了通过考试，她必须与搭档共同赢得毕业试演。情感融入音乐，或许能让旋律更加甜美，情侣间的争吵却也可能使创作停滞不前。学会以女友身份与王子们相处，把恋爱的方方面面融入歌曲吧。

《Amazing Aria》加入了可供约会的新角色。如果你在前作中取得了优异成果，可将存档载入新作，把恋爱计量表提升至全新上限。也别忘了欣赏新曲目和新的事件插图。

[摘自[url=http://www.play-asia.com/Uta_no_PrinceSama_Amazing_Aria_Welcome_Set/paOS-13-71-9f-49-en-70-3ymn.html]Play-Asia[/url]]
